title: code.md, backlog.md, the skills and the kb-worker agent ask a new test for one command, gate, format or leak guard only
goal: kb/_self/code.md's Checks and their tests, kb/_self/maintaining.md's Conduct for changes, kb/_self/backlog.md's Definition of done, Checks that prove an item, the planning rules under Sprints and the three test tiers, the kb-item, kb-backlog, kb-sprint and kb-verify skills and .claude/agents/kb-worker.md state the operator's answer to gate g1 as the rule for every new test: by the recommended answer, a test exists only for one command's main path, one planted failure per gate, a machine-read format, or a secret, leak or untrusted-code guard; no parametrize list beyond two cases, no test that reads a doc, skill or agent file to assert its wording, no regression test for a defect whose effect an ops row, querylog.py digest or a gate's own check shows; operational errors are read from the ops rows and the digest. The rules that ask for more (one planted case per goal clause, a test over a range of inputs, a check per state-change path, a real-sample fixture, the job-state table, gap-replay) are gone or optional, bl_check's state-paths warning and its test go with them, and perfcheck.py dropped accepts a group whose reason names the operator's decision as a deliberate cut without a successor test; the decision is recorded in kb/_self's decisions by the gate's answer (backlog.py answer --record).

gates.question: Which rule do code.md, backlog.md, the skills and kb-worker.md state for new tests? minimal = a test exists only for one command's main path, one planted failure per gate, a machine-read format, or a secret, leak or untrusted-code guard; at most two parametrize cases; no test that reads a doc, skill or agent file to assert its wording; no regression test for a defect an ops row, the digest or a gate's check shows; the Definition of done drops 'one planted case per clause of the goal', the planning rules that demand specific tests (range of inputs, a check per state-change path, real-sample fixture, job-state table, gap-replay) go, bl_check's state-paths warning goes, perfcheck dropped accepts a cut naming this decision. moderate = keep one planted failure per gate clause, the real-sample fixture rule and the job-state table; drop only matrices beyond two cases and prose pins. keep = no rule change: the cuts stand as a one-off and the rules stay as written (new work keeps adding tests by them).

EP-hlnsqx4f's outcome says the suites run in minutes on Windows 'with no lost coverage', which the cuts of EP-5o2drech contradict. retitle = the operator retitles it to drop that clause; its open stories (ST-4mcoplex seed pack index, ST-b3bbbbpc hard-linked kb copies, ST-ywqttahe live-data list, ST-xjb4wykm Defender cost, all in SP-qzip6qar) stay for the operator to keep or drop; fold = drop EP-hlnsqx4f's open stories as superseded by EP-5o2drech and delete the epic once they are gone; keep = leave it as it is.

notes: Rule change: blocking operator gates g1 (the rule text; recommended minimal) and g2 (EP-hlnsqx4f's 'no lost coverage'; recommended retitle). The operator's direction of 2026-10-05 (cut aggressively; tests only with a very limited scope; real errors from logs) is the settled principle; g1 confirms the exact rule text. Answer g1 with backlog.py answer ST-f2gtof46 g1 --answer minimal --by operator --record, which writes the active decision the dropped-id reasons and perfcheck dropped can name. Depends on ST-xohqvy5p because the deleted prose pins (test_kb_cohesion.py's plan, review, cost-rerun and touches phrases, test_three_tiers_docs.py, test_worker_brief.py, test_kb_item_reading.py, test_kb_sprint_close_cleanup.py, test_kb_mcp.py's kb-worker pins) would fail the rewrite of these docs. AGENTS.md states no test rule (its 4 KB cap is untouched). The -k selectors the skills name stay selectable after the cuts (ruff or tools_map, leaks or test_no_private_ipv4, Cohesion or SelfDocs, test_lookup_ and passes). The doc citations of deleted tests elsewhere in kb/_self/ go in the docs story that depends on this one; this story removes those in the skills and kb-worker.md it rewrites.
